Package org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker

Class Derived

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker.Derived
public final class Derived extends Object
Declares a derived data source: transforms run in the browser on each new frame of another source, published on data:<as>.

The built-in transforms are bucket, filter, groupBy and topN; app transforms are registered under dotted names. A string arg that is exactly {token} is filled from params.

Example:

page.data(Derived.from("orgRequests") .transform("groupBy", JsonMap.of("by", List.of("reason"), "measures", List.of("count"))) .as("noqcByReason"));

Since:
10.0.0
